newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pacific Concord gets okay sign on spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Concord gets okay sign on spinoff.

text.p: Pacific Concord Holdings Ltd said on Friday its shareholders had approved the spin-off of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Concord Land Development Co Ltd, at an extraordinary general meeting.

The shareholders also approved the transfer of Pacific Concord chairman Wong Sai-chung's interest in two development and investment properties in Beijing and Shenyang, China to Concord Land, it said in a statement.
Pacific Concord's shareholders would be offered on an assured basis one share in Concord Land for every 50 Pacific Concord shares held, it said.
Concord Land had just completed its roadshow in Singapore, Hong Kong, Europe and the U.S. and the response was overwhelming, it added.
